title: Harden CI per DEC-240: no lifecycle scripts, no persisted credentials, exact Quest version, env-passed outputs
description: DEC-240 (opum-doc, 2026-10-25T14:10Z; plan item 13, dec-00icl6f = A) hardens CI in every repository. (1) Install lore and quest in CI with npm install -g --ignore-scripts <pkg>@<exact>. (2) Every actions/checkout step sets persist-credentials: false unless that job pushes with the token; a job that pushes keeps it and says why in a comment. (3) The Quest version is read only from inside the managed Quest block markers and must match ^[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+$ exactly; anything else fails the job by name and never reaches npm as a range. (4) A step output used in a shell step reaches it through env:, never interpolated as ${{ }} inside run:. Items 1 and 3 apply only where this repo CI installs lore or quest; items 2 and 4 apply to every workflow. Out of scope: pinning third-party actions by SHA (Wednesday grooming). DEC-182 (1) floor work: Sonnet or above authors, Opus reviews before landing. The author does not land it.

acceptanceCriteria.text: Every workflow in .github/workflows that installs lore or quest from npm passes --ignore-scripts and an exact version; proved by an install with a dependency carrying a deliberately failing postinstall that still succeeds
Every actions/checkout step sets persist-credentials: false, except a job that pushes with the token, which keeps it and says why in a comment

Wherever a workflow reads the Quest version from CLAUDE.md it reads only inside the managed block markers and requires ^[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+$; proved by a CLAUDE.md with a partial version failing the read by name
No step output is interpolated as ${{ }} inside a run: block; each reaches the shell through env:
Items that do not apply are recorded on this task with what was measured, and no third-party action is re-pinned by SHA

implementationNotes: MEASURED, per item (workflows read at origin/dev 8a3407d3). (1) npm installs of lore/quest: lore-check.yml pinned lore install (now --ignore-scripts) and scripts/qualification/prepublish.mjs lore install (now --ignore-scripts, runs in prepublication-qualification.yml). release.yml installs only npm@^11 and prepublication installs @salient-ai/jira-cli and @anthropic-ai/claude-code: neither is lore or quest, so DEC-240 (1) does not reach them; left as is, not measured for postinstall need. scripts/lore-pin-staleness.mjs readPin regex widened to accept the new install line (qcli358 stays green). Quest itself is not installed from npm in CI: it is built from the checkout. (2) 9 checkout steps across 7 workflows, all now persist-credentials: false. No job pushes with the token (grep for git push/tag/gh release in workflows: none; permissions are contents: read throughout), so no job keeps the credential. (3) The only CLAUDE.md version read is tracker-integrity.yml, which used a loose regex Quest CLI \([0-9][0-9.]*\) accepting a prefix of a partial version; it now calls scripts/read-declared-quest-version.mjs (inside markers only, ^[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+$, fails by name). No CI step passes a Quest version to npm; the rule is enforced anyway. (4) Step outputs interpolated in run: bodies: lore-check.yml steps.lore.outputs.method and release.yml steps.qualification.outputs.run_id, both moved to env:. Other ${{ }} in run: bodies are matrix.target at prepublication-qualification.yml (a literal matrix value, not a step output) left unchanged. PROOF, both ways, test/qcli535-dec240-ci-hardening.test.ts (7 tests): packed dependency with postinstall `exit 1`, npm install --ignore-scripts exits 0 and the control with --dangerously-allow-all-scripts exits nonzero (npm 12.2.0 here blocks scripts by default, npm 11 on runners runs them, so the control forces them on); read-declared-quest-version.mjs given 0.14 / 0 / ^0.14.1 / ~0.14.1 / 0.14.x / 0.14.1-rc.1 / v0.14.1 / 0.14.1.2 exits 1 naming the value on stderr with empty stdout, a good block prints 0.14.1, a version only outside markers is refused. MUTATION: removing one persist-credentials line, re-inlining the run_id expression, and dropping --ignore-scripts from the lore install turned exactly those three scan tests red (4 pass, 3 fail); restored 7/7. Local: typecheck, format, layer, lockfile pins pass; lint has the same 8 pre-existing warnings; the only failing test in the touched set is the known QCLI-411 bun 1.3.14 pin check.

REVIEW ROUND 1 (Opus REQUEST_CHANGES at cb9b526, token d240-qcli-rc) and CORRECTIONS to my earlier note. CORRECTED: (a) there are 10 actions/checkout steps (lore-check 1, lore-pin-staleness 1, prepublication-qualification 4, projection-platform 1, promotion-guardrails 1, release 1, tracker-integrity 1), not 9; the test floor is now exactly 10. (b) scripts/qualification/prepublish.mjs installs QUEST from local tarballs (candidate_clean_install), not lore, and ALREADY carried --ignore-scripts at origin/dev; I did not change it and my earlier note said I did. F1 (blocking, fixed): scripts/lore-pin-staleness.mjs exportSchemas ran npm install --prefix <tool> @opum-ai/lore@<version> with no --ignore-scripts on the weekly lore-pin-staleness.yml runner holding GH_TOKEN (issues: write); it now passes --ignore-scripts, and the install scan reads every script under scripts/ and scripts/qualification (not only workflow lines) and requires --ignore-scripts on every "npm" install array (at least 2 found: exportSchemas and the candidate clean install). F3: read-declared-quest-version.mjs requires each marker exactly once and in order; tests cover a repeated begin, repeated end, two whole blocks, reversed, no end, no begin, and CRLF (reads 0.14.1; a partial version under CRLF still refused). F4: both control arms now carry --dangerously-allow-all-scripts so they differ only by --ignore-scripts, the postinstall echoes DEC240_POSTINSTALL_RAN, the hardened arm exits 0 without that marker in its output and the control exits nonzero WITH it. F5: lore-check.yml bun-version now assigns bun_version="$(cat ...)" on its own line before the echo; release.yml three --version "$(node -p ...)" arguments (e2e-receipt, bundle-integrity, release-provenance) now assign a variable first under set -euo pipefail. F6 measured 2026-10-26T14:23Z: gh repo view opum-ai/quest-cli --json visibility returns PUBLIC. scripts/qualification/promotion-fast-forward.mjs (git fetch dev, promotion-guardrails.yml) and release-provenance.mjs (git fetch --quiet origin main, release.yml) fetch from origin with no persisted credential after persist-credentials: false, so they work unauthenticated only because this repository is public; if it were made private both would fail at the fetch and persist-credentials would have to be revisited per job. F7 (does DEC-240 (1) cover the DEC-169 source-fallback bun install --frozen-lockfile) goes to opum-doc and nothing was changed for it. Mutation, round 2: dropping --ignore-scripts from exportSchemas and loosening the marker count to < 1 turned exactly the install scan and the marker test red (7 pass, 2 fail); restored 9/9. The earlier mutation (persist-credentials, run_id interpolation, lore --ignore-scripts) is unchanged.

REVIEW ROUND 2 (Opus APPROVE rv327-qcli684b at 460b13b; leader token d240-qcli-fix). Fixed: F2 residual (CHANGELOG no longer says a release-time lore install; the second lore install is the weekly exportSchemas in lore-pin-staleness.mjs); N2 (the control postinstall now writes a sentinel FILE at a path npm failure text never names, asserted present in the control and absent in the hardened arm; mutation: dropping --ignore-scripts from the hardened arm turned that test red, restored 10/10); N5 (a missing or unreadable CLAUDE.md fails with a named ::error and ENOENT, tested). FOLLOW-UPS, recorded and not built: N1 (the install and output scans are narrower than their titles say: the install scan matches only the literal "npm", [ ... "install" ... ] array form in scripts/ and scripts/qualification, and the output scan only the steps. expression form). N3 and N4 were named by the leader but their text was not relayed to me, so they are not described here; they will be added when the text is supplied.

Follow-ups N1, N3 and N4 from the Opus review (rv327-qcli684b), not built: filed as QCLI-536. N3 verbatim: The proof installs the failing package as the top-level spec via --prefix, but the CI threat is a transitive dependency under -g. The conclusion holds; the object tested differs by one hop. N4 verbatim: Two $(...) calls remain inside arguments, both in diagnostic echoes only: release.yml:88 and lore-check.yml:267. Neither feeds a gate. DEC-240 (a3) (opum-doc, via the leader): item 1 covers every install of the lore or quest packages anywhere in CI including helpers; a project own dependency install is out of DEC-240, including the DEC-169 lore-cli source fallback bun install, so F7 needed no change.
finalSummary: PR #684, squash-merged as ab5cb303 on dev: DEC-240 CI hardening. persist-credentials: false on all 10 checkout steps (no job pushes with the token); --ignore-scripts on the pinned lore install in lore-check.yml and on the lore install in the weekly lore-pin-staleness exportSchemas (the prepublish candidate install already had it); the step outputs in lore-check.yml and release.yml reach their shell through env:; scripts/read-declared-quest-version.mjs reads the Quest version only inside the managed markers (each exactly once), requires exact X.Y.Z, and fails by name, including on a missing file, replacing a loose regex in tracker-integrity.yml. Verified: test/qcli535-dec240-ci-hardening.test.ts (10 tests) with both-ways proofs (a packed dependency whose postinstall writes a sentinel file succeeds under --ignore-scripts with no sentinel, and the forced-scripts control fails with the sentinel present), and mutations that turned exactly the matching scan tests red; CI green on 28b923d3 (source-gates, Tracker integrity, lore check, and lore 0.14.1 installed from npm under --ignore-scripts in the lore check log). Two Opus reviews: REQUEST_CHANGES at cb9b526 (one blocking: the exportSchemas install), APPROVE at 460b13b, leader read of the final delta. No action pinned by SHA, by ruling. Follow-ups N1, N3, N4 are QCLI-536.
